row: Espanola Animal Hospital has earned a reputation for excellence across Ontario and beyond. We have a special interest in orthopedic and spinal surgery as well as other advanced diagnostic and surgical procedures. We’re focused on providing the latest therapies combined with compassionate care, delivered by a highly trained team.
